targets.title: Is heart rate variability related to season of birth?
targets.evidence_quote: The aim of the current study was to conceptually replicate the findings of Huang et al. (2015).
targets.outcome_quote: In conclusion, with this study we have replicated the earlier study by Huang et al., extending the findings to the full age lifespan, a wide geographic distribution, HRV measurements throughout the year, and additional measures that could be of interest to better understand the relationship between HRV and seasonality.
targets.outcome_reasoning: The final conclusion gives an explicit overall replicated verdict. This takes precedence over the noted differences in climatic and age associations.

reasoning: A different existing multicenter sample retests Huang et al.; using existing data does not make it a reproduction of the original data. Other age, sex and symptom comparisons are extensions or contextual comparisons rather than designated replication targets.
